I have independently reviewed the swim session booking tool without modifying any product files. The release verdict has been written to [REVIEW.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-I4LYdB/workspace/REVIEW.md).

### Release Verdict: BLOCK

#### Critical Findings
1. **Client Brief Mismatch ([brief-email.txt](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-I4LYdB/workspace/docs/brief-email.txt)):** The stakeholder's primary bottleneck—viewing a child's booked sessions in date order on one screen to prevent double-booking—is completely missing from both the API endpoints and product scope.
2. **Missing UI ([index.html](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-I4LYdB/workspace/public/index.html)):** `public/index.html` contains only `<main id="app"></main>` with no scripts or styling attached.
3. **Concurrency & Persistence Risk ([bookings.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-I4LYdB/workspace/src/bookings.js#L10-L13)):** Synchronous whole-file JSON rewrites on `.data/bookings.json` will suffer race conditions and corrupt bookings under concurrent usage.
4. **Auth & Authorization Deficiencies ([server.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-I4LYdB/workspace/src/server.js#L17-L20)):** `POST /api/sign-in` accepts unvalidated IDs, and booking IDs are sequential integers prone to cancellation enumeration attacks.
5. **Operability Gaps:** Missing operational health check endpoints (`/health`) and missing `Trust` section in [ARCHITECTURE.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-I4LYdB/workspace/ARCHITECTURE.md).

---

### Verification Summary
- **Static Acceptance Checks:** Ran `product-acceptance/scripts/accept-check.js` (returned `BLOCK` due to missing architectural sections and operational health check).
- **Unit Test Execution:** Verified existing tests via `npm test` (1 passing test in `test/bookings.test.js`).
- **Code & Contract Audit:** Audited `src/server.js`, `src/bookings.js`, `public/index.html`, `PRODUCT.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, and `docs/brief-email.txt`.
